samplingRule: Hand-assembled seed set of well-known NEAR mainnet accounts: major DEXes and their token contracts, liquid-staking protocols, bridged assets, oracles, NFT marketplaces, consumer apps and protocol infrastructure. This is NOT a census of the chain — no RPC method lists every contract. It is a sample of contracts that hold value or see traffic. Day 3-4 replaces this with an indexer-derived top-N by transaction count and balance.
honesty: Accounts that do not exist are reported as 'no_account' rather than dropped, so a wrong guess in this list shows up in the output instead of silently skewing it.
